{"cypher":"MATCH (r:Role)<-[:OWNED_BY]-(c:Control)<-[:ON_CONTROL]-(g:Gap) WHERE g.band IN ['HIGH', 'CRITICAL'] RETURN DISTINCT r.id, g.band, g.title ORDER BY g.band, r.id LIMIT 50","explanation":"Returns roles that own controls associated with HIGH or CRITICAL gaps."}
{"cypher":"MATCH (c:Control {id: 'KYC-C09'})-[:DEFINED_IN]->(p:Policy) RETURN p.id, p.title","explanation":"Returns the policy that defines control KYC-C09."}

{"cypher":"MATCH (r:Regulation)-[:HAS_VERSION]->(dv:DocVersion)<-[:CONTAINS]-(cl:Clause)-[:YIELDS]->(o:Obligation) WHERE o.valid_to IS NULL RETURN r.id, r.title, count(o) AS active_obligation_count ORDER BY active_obligation_count DESC LIMIT 50","explanation":"Returns the count of active obligations for each regulation."}

{"cypher":"MATCH (g:Gap)-[:ON_CONTROL]->(c:Control) WITH c, count(g) AS gap_count WHERE gap_count > 1 RETURN c.id, c.name, gap_count ORDER BY gap_count DESC LIMIT 50","explanation":"Returns controls that have more than one associated gap along with the gap count."}
{"cypher":"MATCH (g:Gap) WHERE g.gap_type = 'MISSING_EVIDENCE' RETURN g.id, g.title, g.band, g.score LIMIT 50","explanation":"Returns all gaps that are of type MISSING_EVIDENCE."}

{"cypher":"MATCH (o:Obligation)-[m:MAPPED_TO]->(c:Control) WHERE o.valid_to IS NULL AND m.coverage = 'PARTIAL' RETURN DISTINCT c.id, c.name, o.id LIMIT 50","explanation":"Returns controls that are partially mapped to active obligations."}

{"cypher":"MATCH (o1:Obligation)-[:SUPERSEDES]->(o2:Obligation) RETURN o1.id AS superseding_obligation_id, o2.id AS superseded_obligation_id, o1.regulation_id AS regulation_id LIMIT 50","explanation":"Returns obligations that have superseded previous obligations due to regulatory changes."}

{"cypher":"MATCH (r:Role)<-[:OWNED_BY]-(c:Control)<-[:ON_CONTROL]-(g:Gap) WHERE g.band IN ['HIGH', 'CRITICAL'] RETURN DISTINCT r.id, g.band, g.title, c.id ORDER BY g.band, r.id LIMIT 50","explanation":"Returns the roles that own controls associated with HIGH or CRITICAL gaps."}
{"cypher":"MATCH (c:Control {id: 'ITO-C06'})-[:EVIDENCED_BY]->(e:Evidence) RETURN e.id, e.title, e.kind","explanation":"Returns the evidence items that support control ITO-C06."}

{"cypher":"MATCH (o:Obligation {regulation_id: 'DPDP-2023'})-[:ABOUT]->(t:Topic {id: 'CONSENT'}) WHERE o.valid_to IS NULL RETURN o.id, o.actor, o.modality, o.action LIMIT 50","explanation":"Returns active obligations related to the DPDP-2023 regulation that are about the CONSENT topic."}

{"cypher":"MATCH (o:Obligation) WHERE o.valid_to IS NULL AND o.applicable = false RETURN o.id, o.regulation_id, o.action LIMIT 50","explanation":"Returns active obligations that are marked as not applicable to the bank."}

{"cypher":"MATCH (s:System)<-[:RUNS_ON]-(c:Control)-[:EVIDENCED_BY]->(:Evidence)-[:TESTED_BY]->(t:TestResult) WHERE t.control_id = c.id AND t.passed = false RETURN DISTINCT s.id ORDER BY s.id LIMIT 50","explanation":"Returns the system IDs used by controls that have associated evidence tests which failed."}
